classification: Behavior-changing observer-consistency defect repair and explicit identity API tightening; no formula, evaluation order or numerical-policy changes.
findings: First-party production matches of ReplaceNode are declaration/definition only; no direct TriangleAdaptive value-copy/move consumers found. Static lexical search is not alias, external-client or preprocessor/compiler proof.
Implicit value copies publish no fresh object identity in node observer lists. Moving had been accepted through copying because the user-declared destructor suppresses an implicit move member.
ReplaceNode rewrites only the first raw vertex pointer and leaves original/destination adjacency inconsistent. A list-node splice repairs this without copying lists or allocating.
Ordinary destruction is unchanged and empty. Constructor-failure rollback remains valid; completed-triangle destruction/adoption failure requires separate qualification.

Geometry caches are intentionally unchanged by replacement. Their refresh policy for different coordinates, general NodeAdaptive value copying, protected vertex mutation and arbitrary subclasses remain open.
SubMesh owner ordering from slice 22 remains qualified. Estimator root ownership, logical rejection and whole-process/parallel/LSan/UBSan remain open.
